messages:
maria: Customer onboarding failing after our IdP cert rotation at ~08:30 UTC. acme-inc reports SSO flow drops to a 404 on our ACS and their users can't reach the app. I decoded the SAMLResponse and saw a 'Recipient mismatch' / Destination mismatch. Can eng please triage?

triage-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-9982 — SSO auth failures (P1).

sam: @maria can you paste the exact ACS URL they POST to and the IdP metadata URL? Did they include RelayState?

maria: ACS requested: https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-inc (we get 404). RelayState present: '/dashboard'. Decoded SAMLResponse error: "DestinationMismatch: expected https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-inc/ but got https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-inc" — looks like trailing slash mismatch.

olivia: That smells like trailing-slash normalization + redirect. We pushed a proxy rewrite change during the cert rotation window earlier today. Could be the LB or proxy altering the Destination URL.

sam: Can you paste the relevant request logs and a quick repro? Also include metadata fetch results.

maria: Logs from auth-service (excerpt):

  WARN 2024-05-12T08:45:02Z SAML recipient mismatch tenant=acme-inc expected="/sso/acs/acme-inc/" got="/sso/acs/acme-inc" trace=abcd1234
  INFO 2024-05-12T08:45:02Z Received IdP POST from 10.4.5.6 relaystate="/dashboard"

When I fetched IdP metadata I saw a 302 redirect to the same path with a trailing slash:

  $ curl -I https://idp.acme.example/metadata
  HTTP/1.1 302 Found
  Location: https://idp.acme.example/metadata/

  $ curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata/ | xmllint --xpath 'string(//EntityDescriptor/@entityID)' -
  https://idp.acme.example/metadata/

sam: So metadata/entityID includes trailing slash, IdP sends Destination with trailing slash. Our proxy or LB likely normalizes and strips the trailing slash on the incoming POST -> causing mismatch. Also you mentioned RelayState — any chance the redirect removed the RelayState?

maria: Yes — in one capture the POST was converted to GET on our edge due to the 302->canonical redirect and the RelayState query/link was lost by the LB rewrite; the user then hits the ACS without RelayState and we 404. Reproduction when I simulate a direct POST to the exact ACS with trailing slash works, but the traffic path with redirect fails.

ian: Hypothesis: the LB HTTP->HTTPS redirect we rolled with cert rotation was configured to strip trailing slashes and drop some query params on 302. Combined with the IdP metadata redirect and destination mismatch, this yields RecipientMismatch and a missing RelayState.

olivia: Quick mitigation options:
  - Add tolerant recipient matching in auth-service to accept both with and without trailing slash for tenant ACS endpoints (canary).
  - Revert LB rewrite that strips trailing slash / preserve POSTs on redirects.
  - Ask customer to change entityID to the exact URL we accept (short-term workaround).

sam: Can you share the exact curl repro you ran?

maria: Repro steps I used locally:

  # simulate IdP POST (base64 elided)
  curl -v -X POST "https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-inc" \n    -d "SAMLResponse=PHNhbWxSZXNwb25zZSB..." \n    -d "RelayState=%2Fdashboard"

  # returned 404 with body 'Recipient mismatch (expected .../acs/acme-inc/)'.

  # Fetch metadata to see redirect behavior
  curl -I https://idp.acme.example/metadata

maria: I also attached the base64-decoded SAMLResponse assertion (sensitive) to the ticket. Customer contact: sso-admin@acme.example — they can test by pointing entityID to the non-redirecting URL or by temporarily posting directly to the trailing-slash URL.

olivia: I'll prepare a small patch for auth-service to tolerate recipient variants and push a canary to staging. If that fixes it, we can roll to prod as a mitigation while infra fixes the LB.

sam: Action items: 
  1) olivia -> canary tolerant recipient match in auth-service (PR + canary today).
  2) infra/eng-sre -> review LB rewrite/redirect rules and preserve POST/RelayState on 302->HTTPS (rollback or config tweak).
  3) support (maria) -> notify customer with workaround and request IdP metadata canonicalization (avoid 302).

ian: tagging eng-sre for LB review: @eng-sre please triage LB redirect behavior and cert-rotation rewrite. :eyes:

triage-bot: Priority escalated to P1 and paging oncall.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the customer and keep this thread posted. :thumbsup:
